facts.text: The upstream controller drives a Thorlabs Elliptec rotation stage
Motor is a pyserial Serial subclass; its constructor opens the port and calls _get_motor_info
The information query is get_['info'] = b'in'
The motor information reply carries Motor Type, Serial No., Year, Firmware, Thread, Hardware, Range and Pulse/Rev
The conversion factor is Range / Pulse/Rev
deg_to_hex uses the integer factor counts_per_rev // range and writes eight hexadecimal digits
A get_ query, a set_ setting and a do_ move are an address digit, a two-letter instruction and optional data
get_ and set_ store the parsed reply in Motor.status instead of returning it
A position reply is a PO or BO code and a 32-bit hexadecimal field
s32 interprets the position field as a signed 32-bit integer
A status reply is a GS code and a hexadecimal error code
Error code 0 is Status OK, 5 is Module Isolated and 12 is Out of Range
The stepsize query instruction is 'gj' and the setting instruction is 'sj'
The parser returns the code and data field of a reply that is not IN, PO, BO or GS
The move commands are home 'ho', forward 'fw', backward 'bw', absolute 'ma' and relative 'mr'
The upstream GUI bounds the step-size slider to 1 to 359 degrees
The upstream GUI bounds the step-size spin box to 1 to 359 degrees
The upstream GUI labels the field Step Size (deg)
The upstream GUI sets both motors' step size from the slider value through deg_to_hex
On slider release the upstream GUI writes the slider value through deg_to_hex and reads it back
The upstream isolate action puts a motor in isolation with set_('isolate', '01')
